title: Data Center Asset & Warehouse Engineer
desc:
Asset Engineer (Data Center / IDC)
Location: Istanbul, Türkiye
Chinese / Mandarin Speaking Required | Global Data Center Projects
TITANICOM is hiring an experienced Asset Engineer to support international data center operations and large-scale IT infrastructure projects in Istanbul, Türkiye.
This is a mid-level position responsible for independently managing day-to-day IDC asset operations, inventory accuracy, warehouse processes, and the full lifecycle of IT equipment.
Job Responsibilities
Independently manage daily IDC asset operations and warehouse processes, including receiving, inbound/outbound registration, inventory control, deployment, return, transfer, and decommissioning.
Manage the full lifecycle of data center IT assets and ensure asset records are complete, accurate, and traceable.
Perform regular inventory checks and audits to ensure the accuracy of asset SN, model, quantity, location, and status.
Operate asset management systems and ticketing/work-order platforms according to established SOP and SLA requirements.
Coordinate with IT, logistics, project, and onsite teams to support equipment delivery, deployment, transfer, and project handover.
Identify and resolve asset discrepancies, process gaps, and operational risks, and provide recommendations for process improvement.
Support project planning, progress tracking, risk control, and operational coordination for asset-related projects.
Ensure compliance with data center security, asset security, and environmental management standards.
Support the management of servers, switches, optical modules, fibers, cables, spare parts, and other data center equipment.
Provide guidance and operational support to junior team members when required.
Requirements
Fluency in Chinese / Mandarin is mandatory for effective communication with Chinese-speaking teams.
1–3 years of relevant experience in data centers, IT asset management, warehouse operations, inventory management, logistics, or related fields.
Hands-on experience with asset inbound/outbound processes, inventory counting, stock control, and asset lifecycle management.
Familiarity with asset management systems, WMS/ERP, ticketing systems, or work-order platforms.
Good understanding of common data center equipment, such as servers, switches, optical modules, fibers, cables, and related components.
Experience working in a data center / IDC environment is strongly preferred.
Ability to independently manage operational tasks, identify problems, and coordinate resolution.
Strong sense of responsibility, attention to detail, execution ability, and teamwork.
Good communication and cross-functional coordination skills.
Working proficiency in Turkish and/or English is preferred.
Ability to work onsite in Istanbul, Türkiye.
What We Offer
Opportunity to participate in large-scale global data center and IT infrastructure projects.
International career development opportunities across European markets.
Professional data center technical training and continuous development.
Exposure to advanced asset management processes and global operational standards.
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
